app.title: CryptoSpread Screener
app.subtitle: mini app
app.devBanner: dev mode: opened outside Telegram, auth stubbed (DEV_FAKE_USER=1).
app.loadError: The server is not responding. Check that the app is running.
app.needTelegram: This is a Telegram mini app. Open it with the MIDNEX button in the @midnexbot chat — outside Telegram the data is unavailable.
app.unauthorized: No access: the app only opens from inside Telegram.

screener.watchlistLimit: Plan limit: up to {{count}} coins for trading
screener.venuePairHint: Pick two exchanges — the spread is measured between them instead of the best of all eight. Order does not matter: the cheaper side is the long.
screener.onlyPositiveNetSub: Hide rows that end up negative after fees
screener.onlyProfitableFundingSub: Hide rows where funding works against us
screener.maxSpreadSub: Cuts off anomalies: a spread of tens of percent is almost always illiquidity, not an opportunity
screener.thresholdHint: Show only coins whose spread between venues is at least the threshold.

positions.title: Positions
positions.autoNote: The bot monitors positions and closes them when the target is reached or a risk condition triggers.
positions.closeConfirmText: {{symbol}} will be closed with market orders on both exchanges at once. Current result: {{pnl}} USDT.
positions.closeFailed: Could not close the position. Try again.

settings.fundingSub: Harvesting the funding rate difference between exchanges
settings.notReady: This section arrives in a later milestone
settings.logoutConfirm: All other devices will be forgotten and the app will close. Sign back in via Telegram — no password needed.

sd.runningSub: Turning it off stops scanning and entering new trades
sd.modeHint: Semi-auto asks for confirmation before every trade; auto does not.
sd.modeAutoSub: Full cycle without confirmations, within risk limits
sd.executionHint: Paper trading fills orders against live prices, but with no money and no exchange keys.
sd.execPaperSub: Simulation on live prices, with fees and slippage
sd.exchangesHint: A spread is measured between two exchanges, so at least two must stay enabled.
sd.minSpreadHint: Fees on 4 market orders eat about 0.22%. A threshold below that guarantees losing trades.
sd.fundingHint: Funding is paid roughly every 8 hours and can either add to the result or wipe it out.
sd.onlyProfitableFundingSub: Skip entry if funding over the holding period turns the trade negative
sd.notifyHint: While you are in the app, alerts appear here only. When it is closed, they go to the bot chat.
sd.notifyOpportunitySub: When a spread crosses the threshold below
sd.notifyRiskSub: Daily loss, spread stop, holding timeout
sd.notifyConfirmSub: Semi-auto is waiting for your decision
sd.riskHint: Defaults are deliberately conservative. Nothing is hardcoded — tune them to your risk.
sd.maxNotionalSub: Upper bound for a single trade
sd.dailyLossSub: The bot stops itself when reached
sd.holdTimeoutSub: Force-close if the spread never converges
sd.entryMechanicsHint: The first leg goes in as a limit order; if it does not fill within the timeout and the spread still holds, it converts to market. The second leg is always market, chasing the size.
sd.paymentsHint: Payments (Telegram Stars and USDT) arrive at stage M6. For now the plan switches freely so limits can be tested.
sd.plan_limited_sub: Trade a list of up to 10 coins
sd.plan_unlimited_sub: Trade with no cap on the coin list
sd.keysSafetyNote: The key must allow futures trading only, with withdrawals disabled and an IP whitelist pinned to the server address.
sd.sessionsHint: A session is a device the app was opened from. Telegram vouches for your identity, so there is no password here.
sd.themeHint: A light theme comes after the dark one is signed off.
sd.languageHint: The language switches instantly and is remembered on this device.
sd.aboutDisclaimer: This app does not provide investment advice. Leveraged futures trading carries a risk of losing funds.
sd.logoutOthersHint: This device stays; the others are forgotten and reappear on their next open.

pd.spreadHint: The position earns as the spread converges. A widening spread is a loss.
pd.targetSpreadSub: Close once the spread converges to this value
pd.stopSpreadSub: Close if the spread widens to this value
pd.resultHint: Fees cover 4 market orders: entry and exit on both legs.
pd.autoCloseNote: The bot closes the position itself when the target spread is reached, the stop triggers, or the holding timeout expires.
pd.cannotEditClosed: A closed position cannot be edited.
pd.exitConditionsHint: Only the exit is editable. Size and leverage of an open position cannot change — that would be a new trade.
pd.editNotAvailable: While the bot is in paper mode these conditions are applied by the simulator. At M5 the exchange will enforce them.
pd.fundingHint: The long leg pays funding and the short leg receives it, so what matters for a paired position is the difference between the rates. It can wipe out the profit from spread convergence.

coin.bestPairHint: Buy where it is cheaper, sell where it is dearer. Below is what survives fees and funding.
coin.fundingNote: funding is shown per payment period, usually 8 hours

md.modeWarming: Connecting to exchanges, showing mock meanwhile
md.universe: Coins on two or more exchanges
md.feedsHint: WS — quotes stream over WebSocket as they change. REST — all tickers polled every two seconds: slower, but works everywhere.
md.fundingUnsupportedHint: These exchanges do not return funding rates in bulk. Pairs involving them show net profit without funding, marked with «?».
md.suspectHint: The spread is implausibly large: this ticker almost certainly refers to different coins on the two exchanges. Excluded from opportunities.

keys.encryptionOff: The server has no encryption key configured (KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY). Accepting keys is disabled — they must never be stored in plain text.
keys.listHint: Tap an exchange to connect a key, re-check it or remove it. Secrets are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and never sent back to the app.
keys.formHint: Create a key in the exchange dashboard with futures trading rights only. The server checks it by reading the balance and — where the exchange allows — the permissions.
keys.pastePassphrase: Passphrase set when creating the key
keys.label: Name (optional)
keys.withdrawalRejected: This key can withdraw funds. It was not saved. Create a new key without withdrawal rights and connect that one.

checklist.futuresOnly: Only futures trading (USDT-M / linear) is allowed. Spot and margin are not needed.
checklist.ipWhitelist: IP whitelist is set to the app server address.
checklist.separateKey: The key was created for this app only and is used nowhere else.

keys.autoChecked: This exchange exposes key permissions via API: a key with withdrawal enabled is rejected automatically.
keys.manualOnly: This exchange does not expose key permissions via API. Check the items above yourself — the app cannot confirm them.

soon.positionsText: Right now MIDNEX works as a screener: it shows spreads between exchanges in real time. The bot that opens and closes pairs on these spreads is being tested and will appear here.

planned.paperSub: Trades on a virtual balance at live prices
planned.autoSub: Opening and closing pairs by target, stop and timeout
planned.riskSub: Limits on positions, leverage and daily loss
planned.keysSub: Trade-only API keys, no withdrawal rights
